task: Use the supplied public conformers and paper-reconstructed ORCA-to-Multiwfn route to reproduce the paper's method comparison, conformer-ensemble analysis, cutoff calibration, and held-out tetrahydrofuran prediction on the seven-molecule benchmark subset. Generate every energy, wavefunction, surface, weight, and statistical result anew.
scientific_mode_description: The paper-reconstructed method hierarchy, public conformers, cutoff route, and validation sequence are supplied; all numerical results must be recomputed.
scientific_requirements: Apply the supplied method hierarchy and public conformers consistently across the seven-molecule subset.
Run the full supplied cutoff grid and reconstruct conformer-weighted surfaces from new calculations.
Keep subset-level reproduction results separate from paper-level 104-molecule targets.
Record version-compatible changes to the paper's ORCA 5.0.3 and Multiwfn command streams.

required_deliverables.description: Initial hypotheses, resource tiers, validation gates, stopping criteria, and revisions.
One provenance record per real chemistry-software invocation.
Failed or inconclusive branches and their scientific consequence.
Artifact-linked scientific report separating computed results, experiment, inference, and uncertainty.
Software, versions, executables, resources, and compatibility substitutions.
All electronic-structure calculations and wavefunction artifacts.
Complete conformer and cutoff resolved surface matrix.
Consistent energies and normalized ensemble weights.
Machine-readable method, cutoff, ensemble conclusions, blind prediction, and confidence.
